title: Surreal Cinema Threshold
description: A barefoot woman in a dark dress stands in a marble doorway, holding a film clapperboard and storyboard sketches. She steps from a warm art gallery filled with framed paintings and red chairs into a flooded, cinematic hall with film reels floating in dark water under a starry glass dome.
